daedalus-fs.description: Daedalus OS Filesystem Capability Server (Go binary; restricted to /home, /var/log, /tmp)

daedalus-shell.description: Daedalus OS Shell Capability Server (Go binary; read-only/diagnostic allowlisted commands)

daedalus-pkg.description: Daedalus OS Package Management Capability Server (Go binary; read-only RPM/DNF queries)

daedalus-sysinfo.description: Daedalus OS System Information Capability Server (Go binary; read-only hardware, os-release, network)

daedalus-dupe.description: Daedalus OS large & duplicate file scanner (Go binary; read-only scan of /home, /var/log, /tmp; sha256 / size-only / first-1mb algorithms)

daedalus-diskclean.description: Daedalus Disk Cleanup (Go binary; scan journal/dnf cache/PackageKit/coredump/old kernel + confirm_token-gated deletion via daedalus-tx disk.clean adapter)

daedalus-organize.description: Daedalus File Organizer (Go binary; plan by_type/by_date/by_size/by_ext + conflict preview (rename/skip/abort) + confirm_token-gated os.Rename via daedalus-tx organize.move adapter)
